title: Mixed Event — Our Precious Memories — Episode5 Dynamic Dodgeball!

meta.Event Outline: As the Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy school year draws to a close, Saki revisits her "100 Things I Want To Do" list. She makes up her mind to cross off the whole list, especially No. 95: "Make lots of fun memories and put them in a photo album!"

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Behind the School

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're up against Mochizuki, Kohane, Otori... And Asahina...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oooh, that team seems tough!
Hona's usually the gentle type, but she's also super athletic...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We drew straws to decide the teams, but this might be a bit unbalanced.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Who's gonna be on the outfield?
Looks like the other team put Honami out...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'll go.
Our team has more people, so let's keep the ball moving between us and make some openings in their defenses.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, we're totally gonna win this!
Go, go, go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I managed to get it, but...
Otori really can throw it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And Asahina is really steady. She's been catching the ball every time with ease...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, we should avoid Otori's attacks as best as possible... And once we have the ball, aim for somebody other than Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We also lost Minori, so now it's three-on-two. We have an advantage, but we can't let our guard down.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. And they have the ball now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry...!
I'll do what I can to support from the outfield!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Both the infield and the outfield, let's all work together and keep on the offensive!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Groan*
Emu's really good at dodging! We can't hit her at all!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... Then, how about we do this?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Otori is already in position to dodge, so I'm sure she'll get away if I throw now. In that case...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, pass it to me next!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huuuh? They sure aren't throwing it at us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They're all passing the ball around so much...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's making it hard to tell when the attack is going to come.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kiritani's coming up from behind Tenma...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, isn't this our chance to get a good photo?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, Shiho, what are you doing?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was great that we managed to hit Otori, but their outfield got so much stronger after that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Honami and Kohane were both really good at passing the ball around, so it took everything I had just to follow where it was going.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ah... Sorry about hitting you, Saki. It didn't hurt, did it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But still!
I had sooo much fun playing with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I had sooo much fun too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks for inviting me, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And Asahina, thank you for joining us!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's no need for that... I had fun too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then let's do this again sometime!
Oh, next time we could do badminton or...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka.
Um... Sorry, come over this way for a second!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, we secretly took some pictures while we were playing. We were just checking if they turned out okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Saki's making an album, right?
So, we're planning to gift her some photos that show her clearly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm sure Saki will like that.
Did you get any good pictures?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We got Saki looking like she's having lots of fun. Oh, Haruka, you also look like you're having fun in this one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is when Saki and I worked together to hit Otori...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. We didn't get your permission to take that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, that's fine! It's just... I guess I was more excited about the game than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (To think... I was smiling like this.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It feels a little bit different from when I'm working...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You look like you're having so much fun! I can see it in the photo.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm...so glad that I switched to the general education course. Even if it was just for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Had I not done that, I don't think I would've ever been able to experience what I did or become close friends with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm planning to make a photo album!
That way, I'll be able to make my memories with everyone last forever!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hey... Do you think I could get this picture too?
